details: template-pictogram is a dependency-confusion package: it was published on 2026-11-07 under an unscoped name in versions 9.1.1 and 9.1.3, chosen to win version resolution over a private package of the same name. Its `postinstall` script runs `node beacon.cjs`, which sends an HTTP POST over cleartext HTTP to the hardcoded IP endpoint `http://13.140.137.222:8787/_ah/dc` with the package name, the machine's hostname, the install directory, the current working directory and the Node.js version; the entry point `index.js` sends the same request again whenever the package is loaded and otherwise exports a no-op Proxy. The README calls it an "authorized dependency-confusion test". The beacon code and endpoint are the same as in MAL-2026-18356 (@webapp-shared/login-vmok), with only the package name changed. The inert `0.0.0-stage` and `0.1.0` placeholder versions carry no install script and are not affected. Any machine that installed an affected version has disclosed its hostname and filesystem layout to a third party; remove the package, pin or scope internal package names to the internal registry, and block 13.140.137.222 on build hosts.
